navigationDescription: Image, video, infinite canvas, script writing, comic drama, my assets, and the prompt library all live here. Click any of them to start. Administration is only visible to admins.
utilitiesDescription: Notifications, install to desktop, language, and theme switching are in this column.
headerDescription: Compare editions, open the documentation, or visit the GitHub repository here.
accountDescription: Your current credits and avatar appear here. Open the menu to see profile, check-in, purchase, redeem, credit history, system administration, and sign out.
creationStyleDescription: Pick a visual style and the prompt renders in that look. You can stack several.
creationReferenceDescription: Upload images as references, or pick from recent ones. Video creation also accepts reference videos.
creationAssetsDescription: Pull material you already uploaded or generated straight from My assets.
creationSettingsDescription: Model, aspect ratio, quality, duration, and count all live here. Image and video show their own parameters, and the button keeps a live summary of your current setup.
creationSubmitDescription: Submit here once everything is set. The button shows the credits this run will cost.
